title: Case 261: Shari Smith & Debra May Helmick (Part 2/2)

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: Married couple Deborah and Sherwood Helmick worked hard to provide a comfortable life for their three young children.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉和舍伍德·赫尔米克夫妇努力工作，为三个年幼的孩子提供舒适的生活。

sentences.en: In mid-1985, the couple saved enough money to move out of the home they'd been sharing with relatives, and into a space of their own.
sentences.zh: 1985年中期，这对夫妇攒够了钱，搬出了与亲戚合住的房子，搬进了属于他们自己的空间。

sentences.en: The Shiloh Mobile Home Park in South Carolina's Richland County provided modest yet pleasant accommodation.
sentences.zh: 南卡罗来纳州里奇兰县的希洛移动房屋公园提供了简朴而舒适的住所。

sentences.en: With just 13 trailers on the property, it was a relatively close-knit, hard-working community, where residents looked out for one another.
sentences.zh: 这里只有13辆拖车，是一个相对紧密、勤劳的社区，居民们互相照应。

sentences.en: By June, the Helmicks had been living at the trailer park for two months.
sentences.zh: 到了6月份，赫尔米克一家已经在拖车公园住了两个月。

sentences.en: Although their busy schedules didn't leave them much time for socialising with the other tenants, they were starting to settle in.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们忙碌的日程没有给他们留下太多与其他租户社交的时间，但他们开始安定下来。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Friday June 14, Deborah prepared for her waitressing shift at a local barbecue restaurant.
sentences.zh: 6月14日星期五下午，黛博拉为她在当地一家烧烤餐厅的服务员工作准备。

sentences.en: Her husband Sherwood hadn't yet returned home from his construction job, so Deborah had little choice but to bring her three children along for the drive.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫舍伍德还没下工回家，所以黛博拉别无选择，只好把三个孩子一起带上车。

sentences.en: Deborah didn't have a car, but her neighbour Vicky was happy to help out.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉没有车，但她的邻居维姬很乐意帮忙。

sentences.en: Vicky agreed to drop Deborah at the restaurant, and then keep an eye on her kids until Sherwood knocked off from work.
sentences.zh: 维姬同意开车送黛博拉去餐厅，然后帮忙照看她的孩子，直到舍伍德下班。

sentences.en: Just as they were about to leave, Sherwood returned home.
sentences.zh: 正当他们准备出发时，舍伍德回来了。

sentences.en: Six-year-old Becky still wanted to go for the drive, but nine-year-old Deborah May and three-year-old Woody decided to stay home.
sentences.zh: 6岁的贝基仍然想去兜风，但9岁的黛博拉·梅和3岁的伍迪决定留在家里。

sentences.en: The youngsters said goodbye to their mother, then went to play outside, while their father cooled down indoors.
sentences.zh: 孩子们跟母亲道别，然后去外面玩耍，而他们的父亲则在室内纳凉。

sentences.en: Ricky Morgan lived in a neighbouring trailer four doors down.
sentences.zh: 里奇蒙·摩根住在隔壁隔了四户的拖车里。

sentences.en: At around 4pm, he heard a noise outside and looked out the window.
sentences.zh: 下午4点左右，他听到外面有声音，便向窗外望去。

sentences.en: A silver car that Ricky didn't recognise rapidly pulled into the trailer park.
sentences.zh: 一辆里奇不认识的银色轿车快速驶入拖车公园。

sentences.en: It stopped near the two Helmick children who were playing at the front of their trailer.
sentences.zh: 它停在两个正在拖车前玩耍的赫尔米克孩子附近。

sentences.en: A white male got out of the vehicle, leaving his motor running and the door open.
sentences.zh: 一名白人男子从车里出来，车子没熄火，车门也开着。

sentences.en: He walked over and began speaking to the two children.
sentences.zh: 他走过去开始和两个孩子说话。

sentences.en: In his hand appeared to be a white bag.
sentences.zh: 他的手里似乎拿着一个白色的袋子。

sentences.en: Ricky didn't think much of it, assuming he was a friend of the family.
sentences.zh: 里奇没有多想，以为他是这家人的朋友。

sentences.en: But suddenly, the man grabbed Deborah May around to the waist and raced back towards his car.
sentences.zh: 但突然间，那名男子抓住黛博拉·梅的腰，快步跑回车里。

sentences.en: Deborah May began kicking and screaming.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·梅开始踢腿尖叫。

sentences.en: The man threw her into his vehicle, where Deborah May continued to scream and started kicking the roof.
sentences.zh: 男子将她塞进车里，黛博拉·梅在里面继续尖叫并开始踢车顶。

sentences.en: By the time Ricky realised what was happening, it was too late.
sentences.zh: 等里奇意识到发生了什么时，已经太晚了。

sentences.en: He raced outside, but the car sped past him and out of the trailer park.
sentences.zh: 他冲到外面，但汽车从他身边呼啸而过，驶出了拖车公园。

sentences.en: Three-year-old Woody desperately scrambled underneath a nearby bush, shaking with fear.
sentences.zh: 3岁的伍迪拼命钻进附近的一处灌木丛下，吓得浑身发抖。

sentences.en: When asked what happened, a terrified Woody later explained,
sentences.zh: 当被问及发生了什么事时，受惊的伍迪后来解释说，

sentences.en: The bad man said he was coming back to get me.
sentences.zh: 那个坏人说他还要回来抓我。

sentences.en: Sherwood Helmick had been just 20 feet away, getting changed in his bedroom, where the buzzing of his air conditioner unit drowned out the sound of his daughter's screaMs.
sentences.zh: 舍伍德·赫尔米克当时就在20英尺外的卧室里换衣服，空调的嗡嗡声淹没了他女儿的尖叫声。

sentences.en: But a friend who had given him a lift home from work was sitting in the front room of the Helmick's trailer and overheard the commotion.
sentences.zh: 但一个送他下班回家、坐在赫尔米克家客厅里的朋友无意中听到了骚乱。

sentences.en: He told Sherwood what was going on, and the two quickly raced outside, just quick enough to catch a glimpse of the silver car as it disappeared down Old Percival Road,
sentences.zh: 他把发生的事情告诉了舍伍德，两人迅速冲到外面，刚好瞥见银色汽车消失在老佩西瓦尔路上，

sentences.en: a long rural stretch running through the heart of Richland County.
sentences.zh: 那是贯穿里奇兰县中心的一段长长的乡村公路。

sentences.en: They jumped in Sherwood's friend's car and gave chase, but the vehicle was long gone.
sentences.zh: 他们跳上舍伍德朋友的车去追，但车早就没影了。

sentences.en: Officers were alerted, and a search for the nine-year-old kicked off immediately.
sentences.zh: 警方接到报警，随即展开了对这名9岁女孩的搜寻。

sentences.en: Trailer park resident Ricky Morgan had gotten a decent look at the kidnapper, describing him as aged in his early to mid-thirties, five foot nine, and weighing roughly 200 pounds.
sentences.zh: 拖车公园居民里奇·摩根看清了绑架者的外貌，形容他三十岁出头，身高五英尺九英寸，体重约200磅。

sentences.en: He had a brown, receding hairline, short brown beard, and was wearing shorts with a light-coloured, sleeveless top.
sentences.zh: 他有着棕色发际线后移的头发、短短的棕色胡须，穿着短裤和浅色无袖上衣。

sentences.en: The car itself had red stripes down the side and was possibly a 1982 or 1983 model Chevrolet Monte Carlo or Pontiac Grand Prix.
sentences.zh: 汽车本身侧面有红色条纹，可能是一辆1982年或1983款雪佛兰蒙特卡洛或庞蒂亚克大奖赛。

sentences.en: Tire tracks at the trailer park were consistent with it being a General Motors model vehicle.
sentences.zh: 拖车公园的轮胎印与通用汽车车型相符。

sentences.en: Ricky had caught a glimpse of the South Carolina license plate just long enough to see that it started with the letter D.
sentences.zh: 里奇瞥了一眼南卡罗来纳州的车牌，只够看到它是以字母D开头的。

sentences.en: The Helmicks were beside themselves.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米克夫妇急得团团转。

sentences.en: They had no known enemies and couldn't think of anyone who would want to harm their daughter.
sentences.zh: 他们没有已知的仇人，也想不出谁会想伤害他们的女儿。

sentences.en: Deborah May was an incredibly smart young girl who was obedient, well-behaved, and a little shy, not the type to speak to strangers.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·梅是一个极其聪明的年轻女孩，她听话、乖巧、略带羞涩，不是那种会跟陌生人说话的人。

sentences.en: Although the Helmicks mostly kept to themselves, neighbours described them as a likeable family.
sentences.zh: 尽管赫尔米克夫妇大多深居简出，但邻居们形容他们是一个讨人喜欢的家庭。

sentences.en: No one had noticed any other suspicious behaviour around the property.
sentences.zh: 没有人注意到该物业周围有任何其他可疑行为。

sentences.en: The only plausible explanation seemed to be that Deborah May had been the target of an opportunistic predator.
sentences.zh: 唯一的合理解释似乎是黛博拉·梅成为了机会主义掠食者的目标。

sentences.en: For investigators, there were a couple of details that caused particular concern.
sentences.zh: 对调查人员来说，有几个细节引起了特别的关注。

sentences.en: Deborah May Helmick's abduction had occurred on the two-week anniversary of Shari Smith's kidnapping, right down to the hour.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·梅·赫尔米克的绑架案恰好发生在夏莉·史密斯绑架案两周纪念日的整整那一小时。

sentences.en: The two girls lived roughly 24 miles apart.
sentences.zh: 这两个女孩居住的距离大约为24英里。

sentences.en: Both had been brazenly taken from the front of their own homes while their parents stood nearby, oblivious to what was happening.
sentences.zh: 两人都是在父母站在附近、对发生的事情浑然不觉的情况下，在大白天从自己家门前被公然带走的。

sentences.en: Although there was an eight-year age difference between Shari and Deborah May, they shared similar physical characteristics.
sentences.zh: 尽管夏莉和黛博拉·梅之间有八岁的年龄差，但她们有着相似的身体特征。

sentences.en: Both were blonde with blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 两人都是金发蓝眼。

sentences.en: There were immediate concerns that Deborah May could have fallen victim to the same fate as Shari.
sentences.zh: 人们立即担心黛博拉·梅可能会遭遇与夏莉相同的命运。

sentences.en: At the time of her kidnapping, nine days had passed since Shari Smith's body had been discovered,
sentences.zh: 在她被绑架时，夏莉·史密斯的遗体被发现已经过去九天了，

sentences.en: and despite their tireless efforts, investigators were no closer to identifying her killer.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们进行了不懈的努力，调查人员仍然没有更接近确认她的凶手。

sentences.en: Witness Ricky Morgan was shown the suspect sketch of Shari's abductor and noticed similarities to the man who had taken Deborah May.
sentences.zh: 目击者里奇·摩根看到了夏莉绑架者的嫌疑人画像，并注意到与带走黛博拉·梅的男子有相似之处。

sentences.en: Although the man Ricky witnessed was younger and stockier, with darker hair and a beard, he also drove a completely different vehicle.
sentences.zh: 虽然里奇目击的男子更年轻、更壮实，有着更深的头发和胡子，但他也开着一辆完全不同的车。

sentences.en: It was believed that Shari had been forced into her attacker's car at gunpoint, yet Deborah May had been physically grabbed.
sentences.zh: 据信夏莉是被持枪逼上袭击者的车的，而黛博拉·梅则是被强行抓走的。

sentences.en: If the two attacks weren't linked, this prompted another terrifying possibility.
sentences.zh: 如果这两起袭击没有关联，这就引发了另一种可怕的可能性。

sentences.en: What if Shari's killer had inspired a copycat?
sentences.zh: 如果夏莉的凶手激起了模仿作案呢？

sentences.en: If the same perpetrator was responsible for both abductions, police held grave concerns for Deborah May's welfare.
sentences.zh: 如果同一名凶手对这两起绑架事件负责，警方对黛博拉·梅的安全深表担忧。

sentences.en: They wasted no time in launching a full-scale investigation, with officers from surrounding counties called in to assist, while helicopters surveilled overhead.
sentences.zh: 他们毫不迟疑地展开了全面调查，召集周边县的警官协助，直升机在头顶进行监视。

sentences.en: If the Smith case had taught them anything, it was that the perpetrator thrived on power and attention.
sentences.zh: 如果史密斯案教会了他们什么，那就是凶手靠权力和关注度来滋养。

sentences.en: Investigators therefore anticipated that if the same person was responsible for both crimes, it was a matter of time before he contacted Deborah May's family.
sentences.zh: 因此，调查人员预计，如果同一个人对这两起犯罪负责，他联系黛博拉·梅的家人只是时间问题。

sentences.en: But there was one issue.
sentences.zh: 但有一个问题。

sentences.en: The Helmicks didn't have a phone.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米克家没有电话。

sentences.en: If the nine-year-old had been targeted at random, the perpetrator likely didn't know this.
sentences.zh: 如果这个9岁女孩是随机成为目标的，凶手可能并不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Instead, investigators monitored the phone in the manager's office of the trailer park.
sentences.zh: 相反，调查人员监控了拖车公园经理办公室的电话。

sentences.en: But the days ticked by, and the kidnapper remained silent.
sentences.zh: 但日子一天天过去，绑架者依然沉默不语。

sentences.en: When the Smith family found out about Deborah May's abduction, the first thing they did was pray for the Helmicks.
sentences.zh: 当史密斯一家得知黛博拉·梅被绑架的消息时，他们做的第一件事就是为赫尔米克一家祈祷。

sentences.en: They told reporters,
sentences.zh: 他们告诉记者：

sentences.en: We knew when we lost Shari that no one could give us as much comfort as God.
sentences.zh: 在我们失去夏莉时，我们知道没有什么能比上帝给予我们更多的安慰。

sentences.en: That was able to strengthen us, and we want to pass that along.
sentences.zh: 这让我们变得坚强，我们希望把这份坚强传递下去。

sentences.en: Unlike the Smith family, the Helmicks refrained from making any public appeals.
sentences.zh: 与史密斯家族不同，赫尔米克夫妇没有发表任何公开呼吁。

sentences.en: They were too traumatised.
sentences.zh: 他们遭受了太大的精神打击。

sentences.en: Sherwood was unable to cope with the fact that his daughter had been taken while he was mere metres away, and he wept uncontrollably.
sentences.zh: 舍伍德无法接受女儿在自己仅几米远的地方被带走的事实，他痛哭流涕，无法自拔。

sentences.en: His wife Deborah sunk into a deep depression, blacking out from stress and requiring medical care.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子黛博拉陷入了重度抑郁，因压力过大而昏厥，需要接受医疗护理。

sentences.en: They clung desperately onto the hope that Deborah May would be found alive, but the very real possibility that that may not be the case left them crippled with the stress.
sentences.zh: 他们死死抓住黛博拉·梅会被活着找到的希望，但现实中这种可能性微乎其微，这让他们因压力而崩溃。

sentences.en: Sherwood refused to let his other two children out of his sight.
sentences.zh: 舍伍德拒绝让他的另外两个孩子离开他的视线。

sentences.en: When he finally summoned the strength to speak to a reporter for the Columbia Record, he said,
sentences.zh: 当他终于鼓起勇气接受《哥伦比亚纪事报》记者的采访时，他说：

sentences.en: You've got a wacko out there, and you never know what he might do.
sentences.zh: 外面有个疯子，你永远不知道他会做出什么事来。

sentences.en: Up until this point, the composite sketch of Sherry Smith's abductor had been withheld from the public.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，谢里·史密斯绑架者的合成画像一直对公众保密。

sentences.en: Desperate for leads, the decision was made to release it for the first time.
sentences.zh: 为了寻找破案线索，他们决定首次将其公之于众。

sentences.en: It prompted an overwhelming response.
sentences.zh: 这引发了排山倒海般的反响。

sentences.en: With the abduction of a second young girl from neighbouring counties, the already fearful community became increasingly paranoid.
sentences.zh: 随着邻近县发生第二起年轻女孩被绑架事件，原本就恐惧的社区变得日益偏执。

sentences.en: Everyone was viewed with suspicion.
sentences.zh: 每个人都被投以怀疑的目光。

sentences.en: Police tip lines rang off the hook, with locals wanting to report everything from psychic visions to their own personal theories.
sentences.zh: 警方的热线电话响个不停，当地人想要举报从通灵感应到他们自己个人理论的一切内容。

sentences.en: Officers who were already working around the clock to try and solve Sherry Smith's murder were thrown into a spin with the introduction of a second possibly linked case.
sentences.zh: 本已连轴转以试图破获谢里·史密斯谋杀案的警员们，随着第二起可能相关案件的引入而陷入混乱。

sentences.en: Hours of crucial investigative time went into checking license plate numbers,
sentences.zh: 数小时的关键调查时间都花在了核对车牌号上，

sentences.en: as tipsters reported every suspicious bearded man driving a car similar to the ones witnessed during the abductions.
sentences.zh: 因为爆料者举报了所有形迹可疑、开着类似绑架案中目击车辆的留着胡子的男子。

sentences.en: Complicating matters further was the fact that both kidnappings and the dumping of Sherry's body had taken place in different jurisdictions,
sentences.zh: 更复杂的是，两起绑架案和抛弃谢里的尸体发生在不同的司法管辖区，

sentences.en: leading to issues when it came to communication and coordination between the different law enforcement agencies.
sentences.zh: 这导致不同执法机构之间的沟通和协调出现问题。

sentences.en: One official appeared on the news.
sentences.zh: 一位官员出现在新闻节目中。

sentences.en: He's stress evident as he told reporters,
sentences.zh: 他的压力显而易见，他告诉记者：

sentences.en: With the rumour mills swinging into overdrive and wreaking havoc on both investigators and the public,
sentences.zh: 随着谣言四起，给调查人员和公众都带来了严重破坏，

sentences.en: Lexington County Sheriff James Metz took a media vow of silence, refusing to speak about either case until substantial progress was made.
sentences.zh: 列克星敦县警长詹姆斯·梅茨发表了媒体禁言誓言，在取得实质性进展之前拒绝就任何案件发表评论。

sentences.en: Although investigators were treading with caution in case both abductions were linked, they still had no evidence to confirm this.
sentences.zh: 尽管调查人员行事谨慎，以防两起绑架案有关联，但他们仍然没有证据来证实这一点。

sentences.en: Debra May Helmick's case was being treated as a missing person investigation and hopes continued to be held that she'd be found alive.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·梅·赫尔米克的案件被当作失踪人口调查处理，人们依然抱有她能被活着找到的希望。

sentences.en: Just like they had with the Smith case, the community rallied behind the Helmicks, with an outpouring of support in the form of food and financial donations.
sentences.zh: 就像他们在史密斯案中所做的那样，社区支持赫尔米克一家，纷纷通过食物和资金捐赠表达支持。

sentences.en: It was impossible for other parents not to put themselves in the Helmick's shoes, with one woman remarking,
sentences.zh: 其他父母不可能不设身处地为赫尔米克一家着想，一位女性感慨道：

sentences.en: Every time one of my children walks out the door, I pray to God that they'll come back safely.
sentences.zh: 每次我的孩子出门，我都祈求上帝让他们安全回来。

sentences.en: Sherwood Helmick told reporters he was optimistic that investigators would solve his daughter's case within a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 舍伍德·赫尔米克告诉记者，他乐观地认为调查人员能在几天内破获他女儿的案子。

sentences.en: But by the time Shari's killer made contact with Dawn Smith on Saturday June 22,
sentences.zh: 但就在夏莉的凶手于6月22日星期六与道恩·史密斯取得联系时，

sentences.en: Debra May had been missing for eight days.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·梅已经失踪八天了。

sentences.en: As soon as the caller asked Dawn Smith if she had, quote, heard about Debra May Helmick, investigators listening in hung onto his every word.
sentences.zh: 就在来电者问及道恩·史密斯是否，引述，听说过黛布拉·梅·赫尔米克时，监听的调查人员记住了他的每一句话。

sentences.en: Dawn was aware of the young girl's kidnapping, but she responded no.
sentences.zh: 道恩知道这个年轻女孩被绑架的事，但她回答说没有。

sentences.en: Realising he had mispronounced Debra May's surname, the caller corrected himself and said Helmick.
sentences.zh: 意识到自己把黛布拉·梅的姓氏发音读错了，来电者纠正了自己，并说出了赫尔米克。

sentences.en: This time, Dawn responded that yes, she did know about Debra May.
sentences.zh: 这一次，道恩回答说，是的，她确实知道黛布拉·梅。

sentences.en: OK, now listen carefully, said her sister's killer.
sentences.zh: “好了，现在仔细听，”她姐姐的凶手说，

sentences.en: Go one north, well, one weSt.
sentences.zh: “往北走一英里，呃，往西走一英里。

sentences.en: Turn left at Peach Festival Road or Bill's Grill.
sentences.zh: 在桃子节路或比尔烧烤店左转。

sentences.en: Go three and a half miles through Gilbert.
sentences.zh: 穿过吉尔伯特行驶三点五英里。

sentences.en: Turn right.
sentences.zh: 右转。

sentences.en: Last dirt road before you come to stop sign at Two Notch Road.
sentences.zh: 在到达双诺奇路的停车标志前的最后一条土路。

sentences.en: Go through chain and no trespassing sign.
sentences.zh: 穿过铁链和禁止入内标志。

sentences.en: Go fifty yards and to the left go ten yards.
sentences.zh: 走五十码，向左走十码。

sentences.en: Debra May is waiting.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·梅在等着。

sentences.en: God forgive us all.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝宽恕我们所有人。”

sentences.en: The location the caller had described was in Lexington County, roughly 14 miles west of the Smith's home and 30 miles from the Helmicks.
sentences.zh: 来电者所描述的地点位于列克星敦县，大约在史密斯家以西14英里、距离赫尔米克家30英里的地方。

sentences.en: The manner in which he'd given directions was so similar to the way he described the location of Shari's body that officers descending on the scene
sentences.zh: 他指路的方式与他描述夏莉尸体所在位置的方式如此相似，以至于赶赴现场的警官们

sentences.en: had little doubt as to what they would find there.
sentences.zh: 对他们在那里会发现什么几乎毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Following the instructions took them to a remote location in the back roads outside the small town of Gilbert, where they located the No Trespassing sign as described.
sentences.zh: 按照指示，他们来到了小镇吉尔伯特郊外乡间小路的一处偏远地点，在那里找到了如描述般的“严禁入内”标志。

sentences.en: It led down a hill that backed onto a wooded area.
sentences.zh: 它通向一个背靠林区的山坡。

sentences.en: At the bottom of the hill lay the body of Debra May Helmick.
sentences.zh: 山坡下躺着黛布拉·梅·赫尔米克的尸体。

sentences.en: As with Shari Smith, Debra May's body was severely decomposed to the point that her exact cause of death couldn't be ascertained.
sentences.zh: 与夏莉·史密斯一样，黛布拉·梅的尸体严重腐烂，以至于无法确定她确切的死因。

sentences.en: However, the residue of adhesive material in her hair indicated that she too had likely been suffocated.
sentences.zh: 然而，她头发中残留的粘合剂物质表明她也可能曾被窒息。

sentences.en: The nine-year-old was still dressed in the same clothing she'd been wearing at the time of her abduction, pinstriped shorts and a lavender-coloured T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 这个9岁女孩仍然穿着她被绑架时穿的那套衣服，条纹短裤和一件薰衣草色的T恤。

sentences.en: The level of decomposition meant it couldn't be determined whether she'd been sexually assaulted, but evidence found on her body
sentences.zh: 腐烂程度意味着无法确定她是否遭到性侵犯，但从她身上发现的证据

sentences.en: indicated there was a sexual motivation to the crime.
sentences.zh: 表明这起犯罪存在性动机。

sentences.en: Debra May was still wearing the same pair of cotton underwear she'd been dressed in on the day of her kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·梅仍然穿着她在被绑架当天穿的那条棉质内裤。

sentences.en: But over the top was a pair of adult women's silk bikini briefs.
sentences.zh: 但在外面套着一条成年女性的丝绸比基尼内裤。

sentences.en: When criminal profiler John Douglas heard this detail, it gave him further insight into what kind of perpetrator they were dealing with.
sentences.zh: 当犯罪侧写师约翰·道格拉斯听到这个细节时，他对他们所面对的凶手类型有了更深入的了解。

sentences.en: As explained in his book, When a Killer Calls,
sentences.zh: 正如在他的书《当凶手来电》中所解释的那样，

sentences.en: Douglas suspected that the killer wouldn't feel particularly good about taking a child victim.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯怀疑凶手对于带走一个儿童受害者并不感到特别好过。

sentences.en: With Shari Smith, he could convince himself that the two had some kind of reasonable relationship.
sentences.zh: 对于夏莉·史密斯，他可以让自己相信两人之间某种程度上存在某种合理的联系。

sentences.en: Without this delusion, he would likely feel somewhat ashamed of his actions.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这种妄想，他可能会对自己的行为感到有些羞愧。

sentences.en: Douglas believed it was likely that the adult underwear belonged to another of the killer's victiMs.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯认为，成年内裤很可能属于凶手的另一名受害者。

sentences.en: By putting them on Debra May, it was possible he was trying to diminish his guilt about attacking a child.
sentences.zh: 通过把它们穿在黛博拉·梅身上，他可能是在试图减轻他对袭击儿童的负罪感。

sentences.en: The call placed to Dawn Smith was traced to a payphone outside a Kentucky Fried Chicken fast food restaurant in the South Carolina town of Sumter,
sentences.zh: 打给道恩·史密斯的电话被追踪到南卡罗来纳州萨姆特镇一家肯德基快餐店外面的公用电话，

sentences.en: roughly 72 miles from where Debra May's body was found.
sentences.zh: 距离发现黛布拉·梅尸体的地方大约72英里。

sentences.en: As was the case with all his previous calls, the killer had left behind no discernible clues.
sentences.zh: 正如他以前所有的电话一样，凶手没有留下任何明显的线索。

sentences.en: But with the addition of a second body and a second crime scene, investigators were able to piece together a few more details about the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 但随着第二具尸体和第二个犯罪现场的出现，调查人员能够拼凑出关于凶手的更多细节。

sentences.en: The remote location where Debra May's body was found added further weight to the belief that the killer lived locally.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·梅的尸体被发现的偏远地点，进一步加重了凶手住在当地这一看法。

sentences.en: Like the Masonic Lodge where Shari's body was dumped, this wasn't the kind of location one would just stumble upon by accident.
sentences.zh: 就像抛弃谢丽尸体的共济会会所一样，这并不是那种人们会偶然闯入的地方。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the fact that he'd scattered his crimes among three different counties supported the theory that he had knowledge of forensic proceedings.
sentences.zh: 此外，他将罪行分散在三个不同的县，这一事实支持了他懂法医程序的理论。

sentences.en: Investigators believed he'd intentionally spread his offences between jurisdictions, knowing it would hinder the investigation.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，他是故意将罪行分散在不同辖区，因为他知道这会阻碍调查。

sentences.en: By this point, 22 days had passed since Shari Smith had been abducted.
sentences.zh: 到此时，距离谢丽·史密斯被绑架已经过去22天了。

sentences.en: In that time, the perpetrator had successfully pulled off a second abduction and two murders.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，凶手成功实施了第二次绑架和两起谋杀。

sentences.en: He'd made multiple calls to Shari Smith's family and one to news reporter Charlie Keys.
sentences.zh: 他曾多次给谢丽·史密斯的家人打电话，还给新闻记者查理·凯斯打过一次。

sentences.en: Yet, despite unrelenting efforts made by multiple law enforcement agencies, including the FBI, no prime suspects had emerged.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管包括联邦调查局在内的多个执法机构做出了不懈努力，但仍未出现主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: On his latest call to Dawn Smith, the killer didn't disguise his voice.
sentences.zh: 在最近一次打给道恩·史密斯的电话中，凶手并没有伪装声音。

sentences.en: This indicated two possibilities.
sentences.zh: 这表明有两种可能。

sentences.en: Either he was getting sloppy or he was getting cocky.
sentences.zh: 要么他开始变马虎了，要么他变得盲目自大了。

sentences.en: The Helmicks were saved from having to view their daughter's body by identifying her based on her clothing instead.
sentences.zh: 赫尔米克一家没有去看女儿的遗体，而是通过衣物辨认了她，从而免受了这种痛苦。

sentences.en: As soon as Deborah Helmick saw the pink hair clip she'd placed in her daughter's hair before leaving for work on the day of the abduction, her worst nightmare was confirmed.
sentences.zh: 黛博拉·赫尔米克一看到那个粉红色的发夹——那是她在绑架当天上班前别在女儿头上的——她最恐惧的噩梦便得到了证实。

sentences.en: As the grieving parents came to terms with their loss, a press conference was held for police to break the news to the public.
sentences.zh: 正当悲痛欲伤的父母接受这一损失时，警方召开了一场新闻发布会，向公众公布这一消息。

sentences.en: Sheriff James Metz reluctantly confirmed what everyone had been fearing since Deborah May was taken.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·梅茨警长勉强证实了自从黛布拉·梅被绑架以来所有人一直在担心的事情。

sentences.en: A serial killer was on the loose.
sentences.zh: 一个连环杀手在逃。

sentences.en: Metz urged parents to remain vigilant, saying, I don't want to frighten anybody, but as your sheriff, it is my duty to tell you that you should exercise extra caution
sentences.zh: 梅茨敦促父母保持警惕，并说道：我不想吓唬任何人，但作为你们的警长，我有责任告诉你们，你们应该格外小心

sentences.en: during these trying times.
sentences.zh: 在这个艰难的时期。

sentences.en: The suspect sketch was revised to reflect the sightings from both kidnappings and was published in all the local papers.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人画像经过了修改，以反映两次绑架事件中的目击情况，并被刊登在所有当地报纸上。

sentences.en: It showed a white, heavyset male aged between 28 and 35 with longish hair and a dark beard.
sentences.zh: 画像显示，这是一个年龄在28岁到35岁之间的白人壮汉，留着长发和黑胡子。

sentences.en: Although, if profiler John Douglas's assumptions were anything to go by, the perpetrator's physical appearance would likely have changed since his crime spree kicked off.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果犯罪心理画像专家约翰·道格拉斯的推测有什么参考价值的话，凶手的外貌可能自他疯狂作案开始以来已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: He might be losing or gaining weight, looking unkempt, and could be drinking heavily.
sentences.zh: 他可能会体重减轻或增加、看起来不修边幅，并且可能大量饮酒。

sentences.en: If members of the public were paranoid before, they were now well and truly petrified.
sentences.zh: 如果公众以前只是偏执，那么现在他们真的是彻底吓坏了。

sentences.en: Panicked parents vied for a spot in a community program about child safety, while concerned citizens sought out self-defence classes and continued to report
sentences.zh: 惊恐的父母争夺儿童安全社区计划的名额，而忧心忡忡的市民则寻找防身课程，并继续举报

sentences.en: even the most remotely suspicious activity.
sentences.zh: 哪怕是最微不足道的可疑活动。

sentences.en: People called the police to voice concerns that their families could be targeted next.
sentences.zh: 人们打电话给警察，表达他们对家人可能成为下一个目标的担忧。

sentences.en: Tipline switchboards were completely overwhelmed with unsubstantiated rumours, with police becoming so inundated that they threatened to prosecute anyone
sentences.zh: 热线电话总机被未经证实的谣言彻底淹没，警察不堪重负，甚至威胁要起诉任何人

sentences.en: who deliberately hindered the investigation.
sentences.zh: 蓄意阻挠调查的人。

sentences.en: As journalist Margaret O'Shea wrote in the state newspaper,
sentences.zh: 正如记者玛格丽特·奥谢在州立报纸上写的那样，

sentences.en: Other crimes have shocked the public conscience and other murders have provoked community outrage.
sentences.zh: 其他罪行震惊了公众的良知，其他谋杀案激起了社区的愤怒。

sentences.en: But none have so completely gripped the Middellants in intense, pervasive fear as have the abductions and deaths of Shari Smith and Deborah May Helmick.
sentences.zh: 但没有哪起案件能像谢丽·史密斯和黛布拉·梅·赫尔米克的绑架和死亡那样，让米德兰人陷入如此彻底、无孔不入的恐惧之中。

sentences.en: The terror has circumscribed the lives and thoughts of thousands, consumed with the stark and dreadful knowledge that a bold killer, or killers, were at large.
sentences.zh: 这种恐怖限制了成千上万人的生活和思想，他们被一种严酷而可怕的认知所吞噬，即一个或几个胆大妄为的凶手正在逍遥法外。

sentences.en: No driveway, no front yard, no pool or pond, no place where children play could be assumed to be safe anymore.
sentences.zh: 再也没有哪条车道、前院、游泳池或池塘，没有任何儿童玩耍的地方可以被认为是安全的了。

sentences.en: Despite the killer claiming a second victim and the ongoing concerns that Dawn Smith could be targeted next, the Smith family agreed to go ahead with the staged memorial service
sentences.zh: 尽管凶手夺去了第二个受害者的生命，且人们对道恩·史密斯可能成为下一个目标感到持续担忧，但史密斯家族仍同意按计划为谢丽的生日

sentences.en: for Shari's birthday as planned.
sentences.zh: 举行预定的追悼会。

sentences.en: On Tuesday June 25, undercover officers strategically placed themselves around the cemetery while covert security guards lay in wait in case anyone tried to cause any harm.
sentences.zh: 6月25日星期二，便衣警察巧妙地部署在墓地周围，隐蔽的保安人员则在一旁戒备，以防任何人试图造成伤害。

sentences.en: When the service ended,
sentences.zh: 当追悼会结束时，

sentences.en: Dawn took one of Shari's cherished stuffed koalas and placed it on her grave.
sentences.zh: 道恩拿起了谢丽心爱的一个毛绒考拉，把它放在了她的墓碑上。

sentences.en: Various members of the press were there to report on the event in the hopes the media attention would re-engage the killer to make further contact.
sentences.zh: 各路记者齐聚一堂报道这一事件，希望媒体的关注能重新引起凶手的注意，从而让他再次联系。

sentences.en: Speaking afterwards to the Columbia record,
sentences.zh: 事后在接受《哥伦比亚纪事报》采访时，

sentences.en: Bob Smith said the only way they coped was through their belief in God.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·史密斯表示，他们应对这一切的唯一方式就是对上帝的信仰。

sentences.en: Hilda added,
sentences.zh: 希尔达补充说：

sentences.en: It's even harder today knowing that this is the day you gave birth and she's not here with you.
sentences.zh: 今天更加难熬，因为你知道这是你生下她的日子，而她却不在你身边。

sentences.en: Knowing she's not ever going to be here with you again.
sentences.zh: 知道她再也不会回到你身边了。

sentences.en: The following day was Deborah May's funeral.
sentences.zh: 第二天是黛布拉·梅的葬礼。

sentences.en: Over 300 people gathered to mourn the loss of the smart young girl who dreamed of becoming a teacher or school principal.
sentences.zh: 300多人聚集在一起，哀悼这位梦想成为老师或学校校长的聪明年轻女孩的离去。

sentences.en: The presiding minister told those in attendance,
sentences.zh: 主持仪式的牧师对在场的人说：

sentences.en: This is a very difficult time for all of us.
sentences.zh: 对我们所有人来说，这是一个非常艰难的时期。

sentences.en: We are afraid, angry and confused.
sentences.zh: 我们感到害怕、愤怒和困惑。

sentences.en: We are all sad and broken.
sentences.zh: 我们都悲伤欲绝、心碎不已。

sentences.en: We are afraid for our children.
sentences.zh: 我们为我们的孩子感到害怕。

sentences.en: We don't feel safe in our front yards.
sentences.zh: 我们在前院里都感到不安全。

sentences.en: We distrust every stranger.
sentences.zh: 我们不信任每一个陌生人。

sentences.en: We ask,
sentences.zh: 我们在问：

sentences.en: When will it end?
sentences.zh: 这一切什么时候才能结束？

sentences.en: Convinced that the killer could be among the crowd, plainclothes officers were positioned around the cemetery while a police helicopter circled overhead.
sentences.zh: 由于确信凶手可能就在人群中，便衣警察被部署在墓地周围，一架警用直升机在头顶盘旋。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Sherry's gravesite was surveilled around the clock and the license plate of every vehicle that passed by was taken down.
sentences.zh: 谢丽的墓地受到全天候监视，每一个经过的车辆的车牌都被记录下来。

sentences.en: But the trap didn't appear to be working.
sentences.zh: 但这个陷阱似乎并没有起作用。

sentences.en: No one made any attempt to take the stuffed koala, nor had the killer made a peep.
sentences.zh: 没有人试图拿走那个毛绒考拉，凶手也没有发出任何声音。

sentences.en: All that didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 这一切都不重要了。

sentences.en: On the same day that Deborah May Helmick was laid to rest, specialists were finally able to run
sentences.zh: 就在黛布拉·梅·赫尔米克入土为安的同一天，专家们终于能够将
zh_words: 黛布拉·梅·赫尔米克入土为安

sentences.en: Sherry Smith's last will and testament through an electronic detection apparatus, known as an ESDA machine.
sentences.zh: 谢丽·史密斯的最后遗嘱和遗愿放进一台被称为ESDA机器的电子检测设备中进行检测。

sentences.en: With the use of graphite, an ESDA can pick up images that aren't visible to the naked eye, such as indentations left on paper.
sentences.zh: 通过使用石墨，ESDA可以捕捉到肉眼看不见的图像，例如纸上留下的压痕。

sentences.en: The ESDA revealed several latent impressions on Sherry's last will and testament.
sentences.zh: ESDA在谢丽的最后遗嘱上显示出了几个潜在的印痕。

sentences.en: On the same pad she'd used to write her letter, someone had written what appeared to be a grocery liSt.
sentences.zh: 在她用来写信的同一个写字垫上，有人写下了看起来像是一份杂货清单的东西。

sentences.en: But that wasn't all.
sentences.zh: 但不仅如此。

sentences.en: There was a string of numbers.
sentences.zh: 还有一串数字。

sentences.en: Looking closely, investigators realised what they were looking at.
sentences.zh: 仔细观察后，调查人员意识到他们看到的是什么。

sentences.en: A phone number.
sentences.zh: 一个电话号码。

sentences.en: The discovery of a latent phone number on Sherry Smith's final letter was a major breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 在谢丽·史密斯的最后信件上发现潜在的电话号码是一个重大突破。

sentences.en: But there was just one problem.
sentences.zh: 但只有一个问题。

sentences.en: Only nine digits of the ten-digit phone number were visible.
sentences.zh: 这个十位数电话号码只有九位是可见的。

sentences.en: Investigators could make out the first three digits,
sentences.zh: 调查人员辨认出了前三位数字，

sentences.en: This was the interstate area code for Alabama.
sentences.zh: 这是亚拉巴马州的州际区号。

sentences.en: The next three digits were 837, which was the local exchange for Huntsville, an Alabama city roughly 380 miles west of Lexington.
sentences.zh: 接下来的三位数字是837，这是亨茨维尔的本地局号，亨茨维尔是亚拉巴马州的一座城市，大约在莱克星顿以西380英里处。

sentences.en: But of the last four digits, only three were visible.
sentences.zh: 但在最后四位数字中，只有三位是可见的。

sentences.en: This was only a minor setback.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个小挫折。
